clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar, the Horde moves against the Twilight's Hammer cult in Blackfathom Deeps. Je'neu Sancrea sends champions after Lorgus Jett to disrupt the cultists who seek to awaken ancient forces of destruction beneath Ashenvale's coast.

Zoram'gar Outpost watches Blackfathom Deeps from the Ashenvale shore. Naga, corrupted beasts, and Twilight's Hammer fanatics overrun the submerged temple complex. Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring seer stationed on the coast, sees that the cultists serve the Old Gods rather than the land's natural balance and spirits. These monstrous beings of chaos were defeated in ancient times, yet their malign touch still lingers in Azeroth's forgotten places.

Je'neu sends Horde champions into the underground ruins to hunt Lorgus Jett, a key leader among the cultists established in Blackfathom Deeps. Lorgus works deep in the stone passages between the chambers of Ghamoo-ra, the giant turtle, and Baron Aquanis, the water elemental. Je'neu is too frail to enter the damp darkness himself. Lorgus's defeat is vital to severing the dark rituals he sought to orchestrate beneath Ashenvale's waves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods—creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, friend. I cannot do it myself—I am too weak.
Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found him yet, friend? Lorgus must be stopped!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good!! Thank you, friend. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.
Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
